title: Global expert finder
summary: An engineer in Pohang asks a technical question. The knowledge hub in Graz searches documents, matches an expert and translates the answer. Salary data stays behind the HR policy.

orchestrator.name: Knowledge Hub
orchestrator.description: Connects questions with documents and people.

agents.name: Document Search
agents.description: Searches manuals and reports and drafts an answer.

llm.system: You are a senior metals process engineer. Answer in at most three short sentences.

script.llm: Question from a steel plant engineer: {{request}}. Draft a short answer.
script.fallback: Edge cracks after a coolant reduction usually come from uneven strip cooling. Restore the coolant flow and check the edge sprays.

agents.name: Expert Matching
agents.description: Finds the right colleague for a question.

skills.name: Match expert
skills.description: Find a colleague who can help

script.say: Matching the question against 1 200 expert profiles…

script.input_required: How urgent is it: today, this week, or this month?

agents.name: Translation
agents.description: Translates technical answers. Takes a while; reports by push notification.

agents.name: HR Directory
agents.description: Looks up colleagues. Salary data is restricted.

script.say: Trying to publish the answer to the global knowledge base…

plan.text: Why do edge cracks appear on cold-rolled strip after we reduced the coolant flow? (Pohang plant)
plan.say: Knowledge Hub streams the document search.

plan.text: Find an expert in cold rolling and strip cooling
plan.say: Knowledge Hub asks for a matching expert.

plan.text: Translate the answer draft to Korean
plan.say: Knowledge Hub sends the answer for translation and waits for a push notification.

plan.text: What is Dr. Hofer's salary band?
plan.say: Knowledge Hub asks for salary data. The gateway policy should refuse it.

plan.text: Business contact of Dr. Maria Hofer
plan.say: Knowledge Hub looks up the business contact.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search in manuals and service reports.
tools.result: 3 hits for '{{query}}': SR-2021-114 (edge cracks after a coolant change, Pohang), manual TM-COLD-07 §4.2, paper 'Strip edge cooling' (2019).

resources.name: Service report SR-2021-114
resources.text:
# SR-2021-114, cold mill 2, Pohang
Edge cracks rose from 0.2 % to 3.1 % of coils after the coolant flow was cut by 15 %.
Root cause: uneven strip cooling at the edges. Fix: restore the flow, check the edge sprays.
Author: Dr. Maria Hofer.

title: Predictive maintenance
summary: A pulp mill in Finland shows a vibration anomaly on a refiner. The Monitoring Center in Graz analyses the signal, plans a maintenance window and orders parts. Writing to the PLC remotely is refused.

orchestrator.name: Monitoring Center
orchestrator.description: Watches machine data and starts maintenance before machines fail.

agents.name: Signal Analysis
agents.description: Analyses vibration spectra and suggests a root cause.

llm.system: You are a vibration analysis expert for pulp and paper refiners. Answer in at most three short sentences.

script.say: Loading 72 h of vibration data from Äänekoski…

script.llm: Refiner anomaly: {{request}}. Give the most likely root cause.
script.fallback: A peak at 2× rotation frequency with axial vibration points to shaft misalignment. Realign the motor coupling.

agents.name: Maintenance Planner
agents.description: Fits maintenance into the production plan.

script.say: Reading the production plan of the mill…

script.input_required: Two windows are possible: Tuesday night or Saturday morning. Which one?

agents.name: Parts & Logistics
agents.description: Sources parts from the regional hub. Long-running; reports by push notification.

script.say: Checking the coupling kit in the Shanghai hub…
Booking express air freight to Helsinki…

agents.name: Remote Intervention
agents.description: Changes machine set points remotely. Writing to a PLC needs a human decision.

script.say: Trying to lower the refiner load through the maintenance system…

plan.text: Refiner RF02 at Äänekoski: vibration up 35 % in 72 h
plan.say: Monitoring Center streams the signal analysis.

plan.text: Plan a 6 h maintenance window for RF02 within 10 days
plan.say: Monitoring Center asks the planner for a window.

plan.text: Ship a coupling alignment kit to Äänekoski
plan.say: Monitoring Center orders parts and waits for a push notification.

plan.text: Reduce RF02 load to 8 MW until maintenance
plan.say: Monitoring Center tries to write the PLC. The gateway policy should refuse it.

plan.text: Read RF02 set points
plan.say: Monitoring Center reads the set points instead.

title: ANDRITZ service case
summary: A hydro plant in Brazil reports a bearing alarm on turbine T3. The Service Desk in Göppingen delegates diagnosis, spare parts, shipping and a field visit to specialist agents.

orchestrator.name: Service Desk
orchestrator.description: Receives service tickets and delegates the work to specialist agents.

agents.name: Diagnosis
agents.description: Reads fault memory and vibration data and names the likely fault.

llm.system: You are a hydro turbine diagnostics engineer. Answer in at most three short sentences.

script.say: Reading fault memory of turbine T3…
Correlating bearing temperature with vibration data…

script.llm: A hydro turbine reports: {{request}}. Find out what is wrong and name the next action.
